nekkid.definition:
Nekkid is not simply being without clothing--It means you are gettin' nekkid for mischevious purposes. [Naked] is natural; nekkid is [naughty].
> "Come over quick, Shirley! I'm getting nekkid!"

nekton.definition: n. the aggregate of actively swimming animals in a body of water ranging from microscopic organisms to whales

nekulturny.translation: n. 粗鲁的人,不文明的人
